subject: EdgeLabs throughput soak — weekend top-up request
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha@edgelabs.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: carl@yedge.com
Date: Sat, 05 Sep 2026 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Throughput soak this weekend — can we top up credits?

Hi Mateo / Marissa,

We're ready to run a 48-hour throughput soak for the EdgeLabs conversational search pilot and want to confirm we can get a short-term credit top-up for the weekend. Goal is ~2M tokens over 48h (steady-state traffic in our staging). Primary validation: p95 latency under 200ms and no timeouts at 99.9th.

Tentative window: Sat 09/12 00:00 - Sun 09/13 23:59 PDT. Can you confirm how much trial extension / promo credits would be reasonable and whether Redwood can enable higher concurrency for that window? We'll share the runbook and some traffic shapes.

Thanks,
Sam
Samantha Liu
Head of ML Ops, EdgeLabs

Attachment: POC-Soak-Runbook.pdf (pdf, 240KB)

From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 05 Sep 2026 20:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Throughput soak this weekend — can we top up credits?

Hi Sam — thanks for the details and the runbook. Quick answers:
- We can allocate a weekend allowance for a one-off soak; recommended top-up: 2.5M tokens to give a small safety buffer.
- We'll attach a short billing addendum for the promotional uplift so finance has it.
- We can open a temporary concurrency window and pin a compatible model variant to ensure stable p95 behavior.

Before I lock it in I need an approval from Sales Ops for the promo credit and a confirmation from SRE (Jonas) about capacity scheduling. Marissa / Ben — can you sign off on a 2.5M token promotional grant for EDGE-POC-1492 and confirm whether this is chargeable or fully on Redwood promo budget?

Sam — if that works I'll send the formal MAP and the addendum for signatures; if you need additional throughput we can discuss a short reserved capacity for the weekend.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Billing-Addendum.docx (docx, 45KB)

Looping Sales Ops / Ben and Infra (Jonas). Matt — I mean Mateo :)

Ben — propose we approve the 2.5M token promo from our POC budget. EdgeLabs is a good fit for the new throughput playbook and we can treat this as marketing-backed proof (ask them to allow a short case study blurb). Chargeable only if they exceed the allowance; otherwise promo.

Jonas — can infra reserve an extra slot on the west coast pool for 9/12-9/13 and temporarily raise per-customer concurrency to support the traffic shapes in the runbook? If there are conflicts we'll need to coordinate fallback times.

Marissa Cole

We can schedule a temporary slot on the west-coast Dedicated pool and bump per-customer concurrency for that window. Two operational notes:
1) We will pin them on a quantized model variant (reduced memory) to guarantee more stable KV cache behavior across the run.
2) We'll enable prefix caching for repeated prompts and add an auto-fallback to the standard hosted variant if the dedicated pool faces degradation.

Operationally, we need the final list of test IPs and the exact start/end timestamps by EOD Monday to put the capacity block in place. I'll also add an SRE on-call for Saturday night.

Jonas Weber
